{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the 'status' column for any unexpected values or inconsistencies
unique_status = sales_df['status'].unique()

# Count the number of completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Verify that 'completed' is the only non-refunded status
non_refunded_statuses = sales_df[sales_df['status'] != 'refunded']['status'].unique()

# Display results
unique_status, completed_orders, non_refunded_statuses"}
